comment: Default offer sources, shared by the web app and the Android app. Telegram entries read the channel's public web preview (t.me/s/<channel>), which needs no login or API key. Users can add more public channels, or RSS feeds through the code, in Settings. Checked live by CI (npm run probe).

sources.name: DesiDime
sources.note: India's biggest deals community: food, grocery, shopping and bank offers, with the discount in most posts

sources.note: Coupons, flash sales and price-error alerts across 4,000+ stores
